ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (24) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Ми-ти» (Mi-ti) and «Мен-дзе» (Men-dze) are given their established English forms, Mozi and Mencius; «воспитывать» (vospityvat') is 'bring up'. Tolstoy's commercial image «под фирмой любви» (pod firmoy lyubvi, 'under the firm name of love') is kept as 'under the label of love', and «завладели силой людьми» (zavladeli siloy lyud'mi, 'took possession of people by force'), which the website draft had softened to 'gained power over', is restored.
Source observation: [22] «внутренное» (vnutrennoe) for «внутреннее» (vnutrennee, 'inner'): a letter is missing; translated as 'inner'.
